data.title: Vehicle registration appointment on 7 March 2026
data.summary: The vehicle registration office of Kreis Beispielförde confirms your Saturday-service appointment for a vehicle transfer on 7 March 2026 at 10:00, counter 2. The fee is about €37.60.
data.explanation: This confirms your appointment at the vehicle registration office (Zulassungsstelle) to re-register a vehicle (Umschreibung). Bring both parts of the vehicle registration certificate (Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil I and II), the insurance confirmation number (eVB-Nummer), a SEPA direct debit mandate for the vehicle tax (Kfz-Steuer) and your ID card. Expect a fee of about €37.60. If you can't attend, contact the office using the phone number or email on the letter.
